policy.model_threshold_rule: highest distinct validation score with at least 90% recall; flag when probability >= threshold
policy.days_threshold_rule: smallest weekday count with at least 90% recall; flag when weekday count <= threshold
policy.tier_precedence: tier 1 over tier 2 over tier 3; one tier per early-warning assessment
policy.task_deduplication: a task takes the highest tier of any of its early-warning assessments
policy.overdue_assessments: separate urgent-review label; coordinator review required
